messages:
maria.dev: Quick q — UX for narrowing role privileges when a tenant delegates routes to multiple capacity pools. Do we show an 'effective permissions' preview + routing policy impact? Thinking about quotas, fallback routing, and explicit denies.

jason.platform: Short answer: yes. Need an 'Effective permissions' preview and a 'What breaks' highlight. Also useful to indicate which routing policy (e.g. default -> dedicated -> hosted-fallback) will be chosen when quota is hit.

anil-prod: Can we compute that client-side? seems expensive. Prefer a server-side preview endpoint, e.g. `GET /admin/v1/permissions/effective?subject=...&preview=true` that returns a diff.

sophie-ux: UX idea: compact two-column view — left = role editor, right = simulator. Simulator runs a couple sample requests and shows allowed / blocked + which route would be selected and token cost estimate. Quick sketch in thread: 
```
[ Role editor ]    | [Simulator]
- Role: TenantAdmin  |  Request: /v1/generate
- Scope: routes=*     |  Result: allowed
- Deny: billing:delete |  Route: dedicated-fast (quota used 75%)
                     |  Fallback: hosted-standard (if quota exceeded)
```

maria.dev: I like the simulator. Edge cases: inheritance + explicit denies. Must show precedence: explicit deny > role allow > tenant default. Also show when a scope is implicitly widened by group membership.

jason.platform: Also: telemetry. Record when an admin uses 'simulate' for audit and troubleshooting. Maybe make simulation results ephemeral by default but log the event (who ran it, timestamp, sample request). For enterprise customers we might persist full traces for support.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: PR #8123 merged to add the simulate endpoint and initial DB schema for audit logs. CI: passed. :white_check_mark: 

anil-prod: Implementation note: backend runs the policy engine against the sample request. Example request body: `{"subject":"team:billing","resource":"/v1/generate","method":"POST","route_candidates":["dedicated-fast","dedicated-slow","hosted-standard"]}`. Response will include `effective_permissions`, `selected_route`, `cost_estimate_tokens`, and `violations`.

sophie-ux: For UI copy: call the button 'Preview changes' and add a tiny tooltip: 'Simulate a real request to see effective access and routing outcomes'. If simulation uses cached policy state show a warning badge. Also display token-cost delta when enabling a route that would shift traffic to a heavier model.

maria.dev: Action items: @jason.platform add server-side simulator + audit event. @anil-prod keep sim median <200ms for common cases (single route candidate set). @sophie-ux mockups by EOD Fri, include mobile condensed variant. I'll write acceptance criteria and tests.

jason.platform: On it. Filing ENG-PLATFORM ticket ENG-PLATFORM-2287, will link PRs and infra request. Pinged infra for extra CPU for policy evals during peak.

maria.dev: :thumbsup: 

(ends)
